text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity.
            If you still need help, please comment.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity.
            If you still need help, please comment.
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue because it has been stale for too long.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this pull request because it has been stale for too long.
          days-before-issue-stale: 30
          days-before-pr-stale: 30
          days-before-issue-close: 7
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed'
          close-issue-reason: 'not_planned'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'pinned,help wanted'
```
